name: idoxai-document
description: iDox.ai provides high-performance document processing tools for anyone. Developers can find APIs for privacy, legal, and document.

name: text-control-reportingcloud
description: The Text Control ReportingCloud API provides developers with tools to manage templates and to create documents. Some of the various features available are: deleting templates that are stored, accounting for existing templates, storing uploaded templates, create and return thumbnail images of templates, and converting documents to other formats.

name: w3c-web-things-wot-scripting
description: The Web of Things (WoT) Scripting uses WoT interfaces to provide layered interoperability between Things. The W3C Web of Things (WoT) Scripting API is designed to facilitate script runs on a Thing for purposes of discovering and consuming other Things and to expose Things characterized by properties, actions, and events.

name: instaparser-document
description: The Instaparser Document API allows developers to upload HTML code directly in order to parse content that is behind a paywall or otherwise not viewable to the public. Instaparser is a service designed to cleanly pull content from any website so that it can be viewed easily on mobile devices.

name: tableau-document
description: The Tableau Document API provides developers with tools to programmatically make updates to Tableau workbooks and data source files. It allows for modifications without having to hack the XML. Some features include: Getting connection information, updating connection information, and getting field information from data sources and workbooks. Tableau works to help people see and understand their data, and strives to make products and tools that change the way people use their data. For support, start a case at https://www.tableau.com/support/case

name: zoho-office
description: The Zoho Office API is designed for use in the development of document storage applications. Its integration in a business or enterprise document system allows users to open, create, view, and save documents in addition to deploying Zoho web-based editors. Developers are required to submit HTTPS POST requests to be able to deploy the API and accessing documents in Zoho service editors. The APIs documentation provides three URL destinations – that is, Zoho Writer, Zoho Sheet, and Zoho Show – for sending the requests. Whereas Zoho Writer is an online word processing application, Zoho Sheet, and Zoho Show are spreadsheet and online presentation applications, respectively

name: buildsimple-document-verifier
description: The Buildsimple Document Verifier API returns data to upload documents as an importer and an exporter. Resources include example process sequence, job queue, HTTP authentication, and document posting. Buildsimple provides a cloud services for document analysis.

name: whitepaper
description: The Whitepaper API allows developers to retrieve whitepapers for many popular cryptocurrencies and embed them on their web pages. This service offers whitepapers on Bitcoin, Ripple, Stellar, IOTA, TRON, Ethereum, Tether, OmiseGO, Qtum, ICON, Binance, Nano, and many others.

name: muckrock-documentcloud
description: MuckRock DocumentCloud API to build integrations and utilizes DocumentCloud libraries to transition the merger. This API is DocumentCloud Beta documentation and will be updated. The MuckRock DocumentCloud API endpoints are organized around REST operations for: GET, POST, PUT PATCH and DELETE. This API authentication that is utilized via token to access services for; Documents, Projects, Organizations and more. MuckRock builds services to request, analyze and share public records,

name: asposezip
description:
Aspose.ZIP API provides indirect access to Aspose.ZIP .NET SDK -- which enables document compression and decompression. It can compress, decompress ZIP, TAR, GZIP or BZ2 files and archives. API supports ZipCrypto or AES encryption such as AES128, 192 and AES256 as well as user-defined protection via passwords. Developers can easily create archives by adding files and then can encrypt archives as whole or individual entries. Similarly can decrypt whole archive or specific entries.General Features
  • Compress files and folders to ZIP, TAR, GZIP, and BZ2 formats.
  • Compress archives respecting of their structure.
  • Decompress those as per the stored structure.
  • Create archives from one or more documents.
  • Add or delete files from existing archives.
  • Compress documents of all sizes with the help of several CPU cores parallel mod.
  • Support for Zip64 Archives as well as AES 128, 192 and 256 for archives encryption.
  • Ability of whole archive encryption or specific entries with the password.

name: docconversion
description: DocConversion API provides REST protocol to convert Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to images and PDFs. With this service, developers can use a PDF viewer, test the API without code, and manage account administration. An API Key is required to access DocConversion. Tweet @convertapi to get 500 credits at no cost.

name: orange-wifi-locator
description: The Orange Wifi Locator API lets developers to integrate the Orange wifi hotspots locator into their applications, enabling their customers to locate the nearest Orange hotspot in their area. This API is REST based. Orange is a global telecommunication company that provides IT and telecommunications services.

name: mozilla-wifi-information
description: The Mozilla WiFi Information API facilitates Wi-Fi network connectivity to mobile devices running on Firefox OS. Users can deploy the API’s interface to search available Wi-Fi networks in addition to manipulating preferences for connecting or disconnecting networks.

name: groupdocscomparison-cloud
description: The Document Comparison Cloud API allows developers to compare multiple documents with various formats and then manipulate with the changes. This API exposes the REST interface to directly communicate with the RESTful APIs. You can also use any of the platform-specific Cloud SDKs or cURL commands to interact with the API. Supported file formats include; Word Processing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF, emails, images, markup formats and more.

name: ontask
description: OnTask is a workflow automation and eSignature tool with an API for integration. Developers can manage document workflows, templates, and instances with the REST API from Accusoft. The eSignature service is HIPAA, FERPA, AICPA SOC compliant.

name: apimatic-transformer
description: The Transform API allows you to; Convert Uploaded Files, Convert Files Downloaded from Description URL and Convert an Already Uploaded API Description, to formats of your choice. Outputs include; API Blueprint, RAML, Google API Discovery, IODocs, WADL, Swagger and more. APIMATIC provides tools, services, and a way to generate developer kits for your API.

name: w3c-screen-orientation
description: The W3C screen orientation API integrates the changing reading state of a device as landscape or portrait. Users can be informed when the screen orientation changes and can lock the orientation to a specific position. Examples and references available as resources in this standard API that provides a browser architecture.
